title: DonutSMP Shop
description: Restores DonutSMP /shop with a clean client-side panel that makes buying shop items from /ah easier.
body:
## DonutSMP Shop

This mod brings back the classic /shop menu as a clean client-side screen for DonutSMP. Open /shop, browse the menu, and get to the item you want faster with a simple interface that feels close to the
  original server experience.

  Features:

  - Restores the old DonutSMP shop menu
  - Clean, vanilla-style interface
  - Fast category and item navigation
  - Fully client-side

  Important: This mod only helps you navigate the shop. All items are still obtained normally on the server.
